NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Let $\alpha, \alpha+2, \alpha \in \mathbb{Z}$, be the roots of the quadratic equation $x(x+2)+(x+1)(x+3)+(x+2)(x+4)+\dots+(x+n-1)(x+n+1)=4n$ for some $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Then $n+\alpha$ is equal to :
stem.hi: माना $\alpha, \alpha+2, \alpha \in \mathbb{Z}$, द्विघात समीकरण $x(x+2)+(x+1)(x+3)+(x+2)(x+4)+\dots+(x+n-1)(x+n+1)=4n$ के मूल हैं, जहाँ $n \in \mathbb{N}$ है। तब $n+\alpha$ बराबर है :

feynman.en: Add up the $n$ products term by term to get one quadratic in $x$. Its two roots differ by $2$, so its discriminant must be exactly $4$; that fixes $n$, and the sum of roots then fixes $\alpha$.
feynman.hi: $n$ गुणनफलों को पद-दर-पद जोड़कर $x$ में एक द्विघात मिलता है। इसके दोनों मूलों का अंतर $2$ है, इसलिए विविक्तकर ठीक $4$ होना चाहिए; इससे $n$ मिलता है, और फिर मूलों के योग से $\alpha$ मिलता है।

steps.en: Each term is $(x+k)(x+k+2)=x^2+(2k+2)x+k(k+2)$ for $k=0,\dots,n-1$. Summing and dividing by $n$: $x^2+(n+1)x+\frac{(n-1)(2n-1)}{6}+(n-1)-4=0$.
Roots differ by $2$, so the discriminant is $4$: $(n+1)^2-4\left[\frac{(n-1)(2n-1)}{6}+n-5\right]=4$, which simplifies to $n^2=49$, so $n=7$.
